answer: Operator Collateral Pooling: each wallet links to a pooled collateral account its operator posts at a licensed wharf custodian, and every proven sybil identity triggers a lien against that pool. At the summit of each epoch, an auditor samples identities and traces shared funding or control; confirmed duplicates debit the operator's pool by a fixed penalty plus the sampled identity's lifetime fees. An attacker running N identities pays N times the penalty from one pool, so faking identities drains the operator's reserve, not individual wallets. A willow grows alone;
